xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2445: bug(cloister): deacon lifecycle patrol auto-dispatches PLANNING for stale 'planning'-state issues — off-book, and staffed from roles.plan (= Fable) when no model is recorded

plan.title: Gate autonomous planning dispatch behind operator pickup posture; never staff it by silent role default
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The reactive lifecycle scheduler (src/lib/cloister/service-reactive.ts:304-307) autonomously dispatches the plan role via spawnRun(issueId, 'plan') whenever an issue's lifecycle state lands on in_planning (tracker statusChanged events, issue.transitioned, boot-reconciliation replay). It ignores the operator's pickup posture (auto_pickup_backlog flag + released label), and because it passes no model, determineModel resolves roles.plan → workhorse:expensive — the most expensive model, silently. Per the operator's 2026-07-07 comment this is preventive policy hardening (the original incident attribution was withdrawn): (1) autonomous planning dispatch must respect the pickup posture; (2) no autonomous path may silently staff workhorses.expensive — it requires a recorded model or an explicitly designated autonomous model, else surfaces needs-you.
narratives.Proposal: Add a pure decision module src/lib/cloister/autonomous-plan-dispatch.ts: posture gate (allow iff auto_pickup_backlog OR 'released' label, and no parked/vetoed/objection label; fail closed when labels are unavailable) followed by staffing resolution (recorded model from prior plan-role agent state → new roles.plan.autonomousModel config → refuse). Wire it into the reactive scheduler's plan branch only: refusal emits an activity warn entry plus a durable needs-you trip via recordDeadEndNeedsYou(issueId, 'autonomous-plan-dispatch', ...); allowance passes the concrete resolved model to spawnRun. Add the optional camelCase config field roles.plan.autonomousModel (scalar ModelRef, workhorse refs dereferenced via derefWorkhorse, fail-loud validation, NO default). Regression-test the decision matrix and the wiring.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Gating operator-initiated planning paths (pan plan CLI, dashboard start-planning route, pan start auto-plan via agent-spawner.startPlanning) — an operator is in the loop there and roles.plan routing stays as-is
- Gating autonomous work/review/test dispatch staffing (out of scope; file separately if wanted)
- Order-book sequence-membership checks beyond the released/auto-pickup posture — 'released' (PAN-2059) is the operator's per-issue go signal; sequence rank is a priority concern, not a permission concern
- Dashboard Settings UI for autonomousModel (config.yaml only in this issue)
- Changes to deacon-auto-resume planning-session recovery (it resumes existing sessions, never spawns fresh)
- Blocking workhorse:expensive as an explicit autonomousModel value — the rule is no SILENT expensive staffing, not no expensive staffing

autoDecisions.summary: Chose the config-plus-recorded-model staffing option over the recorded-model-only option the issue offered as an alternative: precedence is recorded model → roles.plan.autonomousModel → refuse + needs-you.
autoDecisions.rationale: Superset of both options in the issue body: preserves warm-continuation behavior for issues that already ran planning (recorded model was operator-sanctioned at first spawn), gives the operator one explicit knob for fresh autonomous dispatch, and refuses loudly when neither exists — satisfying the no-hardcoded-fallback rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Posture predicate mirrors only the released/auto-pickup/parked/vetoed/objection parts of isAutoPickable, not ready/planned/inPipeline/epic.
autoDecisions.rationale: Those four gate WORK pickup of planned backlog items; an issue stuck in 'planning' state is definitionally in-pipeline and unplanned, so copying them would make autonomous planning dispatch permanently impossible rather than operator-gated.

autoDecisions.summary: Fail closed (refuse with 'labels-unavailable') when issue labels cannot be read, even with auto_pickup_backlog ON.
autoDecisions.rationale: Blanket release satisfies 'released' but parked/vetoed/objection cannot be verified without labels; refusing is the safe posture for an autonomous spawn, the needs-you trip makes it visible, and the next domain event retries naturally.

autoDecisions.summary: Config key is camelCase roles.plan.autonomousModel rather than the issue's snake_case roles.plan.autonomous_model spelling.
autoDecisions.rationale: RoleConfig YAML keys are camelCase in this codebase (minAgents, maxAgents, reReviewScope); following the existing convention beats matching the issue text's informal spelling.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate wires only into service-reactive.ts's plan dispatch branch.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified it is the single autonomous fresh-planning spawn path: spawnPlanningSession callers are operator-initiated, and deacon-auto-resume explicitly excludes planning agents from resumable roles (isResumableRole, deacon-auto-resume.ts:204).

items.title: Pure autonomous-plan-dispatch decision module with unit test matrix

expected_outputs: autonomous-plan-dispatch.test.ts passes with the full posture/staffing matrix

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/autonomous-plan-dispatch.ts exporting decideAutonomousPlanDispatch(input) per PRD FR-1/D2-D4: input { autoPickupBacklog: boolean; labels: readonly string[] | null; recordedModel?: string; autonomousModel?: string; workhorses: NormalizedConfig['workhorses'] } → { allow: true; model: string; modelSource: 'recorded' | 'autonomousModel' } | { allow: false; code: 'not-released' | 'parked' | 'vetoed' | 'objection' | 'labels-unavailable' | 'no-autonomous-model'; reason: string }. Posture first (labels null → labels-unavailable; parked/legacy-parked/vetoed/objection labels → their code even when released; else released label or autoPickupBacklog required → not-released), then staffing (recordedModel wins; else derefWorkhorse(autonomousModel, { workhorses }, 'roles.plan.autonomousModel') in try/catch — failure or absence → no-autonomous-model). Label matching case-insensitive; import RELEASED_LABEL/PARKED_LABEL/LEGACY_PARKED_LABELS/VETOED_LABEL/OBJECTION_LABEL from src/lib/backlog/pickup.ts, never re-declare strings. reason strings must be operator-standalone sentences naming the levers (release the issue, enable auto-pickup, set roles.plan.autonomousModel, or run pan plan manually). Write the unit matrix test file covering every branch listed in PRD W1.
narrative.Verification: Run the named vitest file and typecheck.

items.title: Given autoPickupBacklog=false and labels without 'released', decideAutonomousPlanDispatch returns allow:false with code 'not-released' (test asserts)
Given a parked, vetoed, or objection label, the function returns allow:false with the matching code even when 'released' is present and autoPickupBacklog is true (test asserts all three)
Given labels === null, the function returns allow:false with code 'labels-unavailable' even when autoPickupBacklog=true (test asserts)
Given posture allows and recordedModel='gpt-5.5', the function returns allow:true with model 'gpt-5.5' and modelSource 'recorded', ignoring autonomousModel (test asserts)

Given posture allows, no recordedModel, and autonomousModel='workhorse:cheap', the function returns the dereferenced concrete model id from workhorses.cheap; with autonomousModel absent it returns allow:false code 'no-autonomous-model' (test asserts both)
Add roles.plan.autonomousModel config field with fail-loud validation and no default

expected_outputs: planning-config tests pass including the new autonomousModel cases

narrative.Action: Add optional autonomousModel?: RoleModelRef (scalar only — reject arrays/percent distributions) to RoleConfig in src/lib/config-yaml/schema.ts (~line 366, beside reReviewScope/minAgents). In src/lib/config-yaml/roles.ts extend the existing per-role validation block (~line 294 where reReviewScope/minAgents are validated) to validate autonomousModel when present: must be a string, must dereference via derefWorkhorse (dangling workhorse slot or malformed ref → throw an Error whose message names roles.<role>.autonomousModel). DEFAULT_ROLES must gain NO autonomousModel entry (DEFAULT_ROLES.plan stays { model: 'workhorse:expensive' }). Inspect src/lib/config-yaml/merge.ts: if role configs merge field-by-field, carry autonomousModel through; if they spread whole objects, no change needed — state which in the commit message. Add tests to src/lib/config-yaml/__tests__/planning-config.test.ts: set value round-trips through load/normalize; unset stays undefined with no default injected; workhorse:nonexistent fails load with an error naming the key; an array value fails load.
narrative.Verification: Run the named vitest file and typecheck.

items.title: Given a config.yaml with roles.plan.autonomousModel: 'workhorse:cheap', load accepts it and the normalized config returns 'workhorse:cheap' for roles.plan.autonomousModel (test asserts)
A config.yaml with roles.plan.autonomousModel: 'workhorse:nonexistent' rejects at load with an error message containing 'roles.plan.autonomousModel' (test asserts)
With the field unset, the normalized config returns undefined for roles.plan.autonomousModel and DEFAULT_ROLES.plan contains no autonomousModel key (test asserts)
Wire posture gate + staffing into the reactive scheduler's plan dispatch with needs-you refusal

expected_outputs: reactive-scheduler tests pass including four new wiring cases (refusal no-spawn + needs-you, autonomousModel spawn, recorded-model spawn, work-role unchanged)

narrative.Action: Add gatherAutonomousPlanDispatchInput(issueId) to src/lib/cloister/autonomous-plan-dispatch.ts: autoPickupBacklog via isFlywheelAutoPickupBacklog() (src/lib/database/app-settings.ts); labels via the issue-service singleton using the SAME lazy require() + try/catch pattern as buildClassifyLookups (src/lib/backlog/lookups.ts:25 — never a static import, that creates the lib→dashboard layering edge), returning null when unavailable; recordedModel from getAgentState('agent-<lower>-plan')?.model then getAgentState('planning-<lower>')?.model (both naming schemes are live per .pan/context/codebase/concerns.md); autonomousModel and workhorses from loadConfigSync().config. In src/lib/cloister/service-reactive.ts onIssueStateChangePromise, change ONLY the final spawnRun block (currently lines 304-307): when role === 'plan', call the decision; on allow:false → console.log, emitActivityEntrySync({ source: 'cloister', level: 'warn', message, issueId }), await recordDeadEndNeedsYou(normalizedIssueId, 'autonomous-plan-dispatch', newState, message) from ./dead-end-trip.js (mirror deacon.ts:1927 usage), and return WITHOUT spawning; on allow:true → spawnRun(normalizedIssueId, 'plan', { prompt: buildReactiveRolePrompt(...), model: decision.model }). The message must state, in complete sentences, that autonomous planning dispatch for <issue> was refused, why (the decision reason), and the operator levers. Work-role dispatch keeps the existing no-model spawnRun call unchanged. Extend the existing vi.mock harness in reactive-scheduler.test.ts (add module-scope mocks for app-settings, dead-end-trip, config load, and the issue-service label source; reset in beforeEach like the existing mocks) with the four wiring cases named in expected_outputs. No execSync and no sync tmux primitives anywhere in the new code.
narrative.Verification: Run both named vitest files and typecheck.

items.title: Given an in_planning event with auto-pickup off and no released label, spawnRun is never called and recordDeadEndNeedsYou is called with recoveryPath 'autonomous-plan-dispatch' plus a warn activity entry is emitted (test asserts)
Given posture allows and roles.plan.autonomousModel is configured with no recorded model, spawnRun receives options.model equal to the dereferenced concrete model id (test asserts)
Given a prior plan-role agent state recording a model, spawnRun receives that recorded model and the config autonomousModel is not used (test asserts)
Given an in_progress event, the work role still dispatches via spawnRun without a model option, byte-identical to current behavior (regression test asserts)
Document autonomous planning gate and roles.plan.autonomousModel in MODEL-CALLS.md and FLYWHEEL.md

expected_outputs: grep shows autonomousModel documented in both files
